notInstalled.blocks: sidebar-app, dialog-sidebar, and queued-stack are composed in apps/app

localPatches.src/lib/icon-context.tsx: Default icon set imports #lib/icons (Lucide with shared size and stroke) instead of lucide-react directly; adds panel-left-collapsed and panel-right-collapsed slots (frame with an inset handle).
localPatches.src/components/sidebar-core.tsx: SidebarTrigger shows the panel icon while open and the collapsed (inset handle) icon while collapsed, instead of one icon in both states.
localPatches.src/components/card.tsx: next/link replaced by a plain anchor so the package stays router-agnostic.
localPatches.src/components/file-thumbnail.tsx: PDF.js worker is bundled through a Vite ?url import instead of loaded from jsDelivr at runtime.
localPatches.src/hooks/use-fluid-hover.ts: holdInGaps option: without nearest, a pointer in empty space between items keeps the current highlight instead of putting it out; used by HoverScope on the marketing nav.
localPatches.src/lib/shape-context.tsx: The pill shape keeps inputs on the rounded radius (rounded-lg); buttons, rows and containers stay pill.
localPatches.src/components/select.tsx: Popup rows sit 4px apart (gap-1 on the rows container), like the dropdown. The inline caret carries .icon-stroke, so it draws the shared icon stroke (globals.css) instead of a 2 stroke.
localPatches.src/components/dropdown.tsx: Popup rows sit 4px apart (gap-1 on the rows container), the spacing every list in the app uses. With a pinned search, the list fades below it (scroll-fade-under-search in globals.css) instead of dropping the fade.
localPatches.src/components/combobox.tsx: The inline caret carries .icon-stroke, so it draws the shared icon stroke (globals.css) instead of a 2 stroke.
localPatches.src/components/input-copy.tsx: The inline check and cross carry .icon-stroke, so they draw the shared icon stroke (globals.css) instead of a 2 stroke.
localPatches.src/components/menu-item.tsx: Optional `detail` prop: a muted caption after the label (filter value counts).
localPatches.src/components/dropdown-search.tsx: Optional `hideIcon` and `trailing` props, for the Linear-style filter field (no magnifier, a shortcut key on the right).
localPatches.src/components/dialog.tsx: The panel sits on surface-1 with its paired shadow instead of four steps above its substrate, and the backdrop blurs the page behind it (backdrop-blur-sm) on top of the same dim (PRE-118). The panel carries .surface-modal (globals.css), which sets the secondary --tint, and the --active and --hover row fills, to the same alpha in both themes (PRE-94). DialogContent forwards initialFocus to Base UI's popup (PRE-94).
localPatches.src/components/mobile-drawer.tsx: The panel sits on surface-1 with its paired shadow and the backdrop blurs the page behind it, matching the dialog, with .surface-modal (PRE-118).
localPatches.src/components/command-menu.tsx: Imports Tabs and TabsItem from #components/tabs (upstream f4867a54 renamed TabsSubtle to Tabs) until command-menu itself is synced; the rest of the file is still at the commit above.
localPatches.src/components/switch.tsx: The on-state track reads var(--switch-on, #6B97FF) and var(--switch-on-hover, #5C89F2) instead of the literals, so globals.css sets it to the brand green (PRE-94).

fluid.stylesheet: src/styles/globals.css follows the Fluid site app/globals.css at the same commit, minus site-only sections, plus the local .surface-modal tint scope (PRE-118), the Preprocess surface ramp and the --switch-on tokens (PRE-94).

partialSync.note: Taken from this later upstream commit ahead of a full sync: Input, Field and Textarea; Tabs (the pill design TabsSubtle was) with the use-fluid-hover item it needs; use-merge-split and size-context, whose differences were non-visual. The rest of the registry is still at the commit above.

removedUpstream.src/components/tabs-subtle.tsx: Upstream f4867a54 (changelog Tabs #96) removed the segmented Tabs and renamed TabsSubtle to Tabs; tabs.tsx is that Tabs now, and tabs-subtle.tsx is gone.

otherComponents.note: Components outside the Fluid registry. Each follows Fluid tokens (shape radius, type roles, hover/active, Elevated); replace with a Fluid equivalent when one ships.
